messages:
Lena (Billing): Customer flagged Feb invoice — their embed generator shows ~9.8k produced, billed amount only 6.1k. They saw many 429s. Can eng confirm billing rules?

Ravi (Eng): We bill only successful ledger writes. Retries that are dropped by edge dedupe/rate-limiter aren't recorded.

Nora (SRE): I pulled edge logs for account 'zephyr' window 2026-02-14 11:00-11:20 UTC. Totals: attempts=9795, counted=6098, dropped=3697.

Tom (Acct Rep): Customer insists retries should count since they generated payloads. Is there any precedent for backfill/credit?

Lena (Billing): Policy: bill on ledger writes. But we can offer a one-time credit for UX confusion caused by our dedupe behavior. Need estimated dollar delta.

Ravi (Eng): Our ledger stores embed_units (per 1k embeddings). Dropped=3697 => embed_units_backfill=ceil(3697/1000)=4. If their unit price is $450, delta = $1,800.

billing-bot: Prepared backfill job id backfill-20260214-zephyr-01 (staging) — preview delta $1,800.

Nora (SRE): Recommend adding a `meter_attempts` metric export to billing UI and an alert when dropped/attempts > 15% for 10m.

Lena (Billing): Approved one-time credit $1,800. Tom, I'll send the note and include backfill job id. Create tickets: Platform telemetry (P2) and Docs billing clarification (P3).

Tom (Acct Rep): I'll coordinate comms with the customer and confirm acceptance of credit.

Ravi (Eng): I'll run the staging backfill and post results.

Lena (Billing): Thanks all, closing after comms.
